summary: First run — full backend (21 pytest cases) + frontend E2E flows all pass. Admin auth, agent apply (Zillow rejection + happy pending + missing attest), lead submission with escrow consent, admin approve, pending-agent cannot login, admin lead assignment (rejects non-approved, accepts approved), agent lists leads, agent close deal with correct escrow math (760k * 3% * 70% * 6% = $957.60, net = $15,960), duplicate close 409, contract PDF (admin + owner allowed, unauth 401), blacklist endpoint, and non-admin 403 all verified. Frontend flows Landing, Lead form (2-step), Agent apply happy + Zillow declined, Login → Admin dashboard (all 4 tabs, approve, assign), Login → Agent dashboard (close-deal-dialog with escrow preview) all render and integrate with backend correctly.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (accessibility warning in console). Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to close-deal-dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.

Optional: pytest.ini forces -n 2 xdist which breaks state-sharing between test classes. Serial run required (`-n 0`). Consider documenting or refactoring to file-scoped state so parallel loadscope works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes cookie (SameSite=None; Secure) auth with Bearer fallback — works fine cross-origin, but note cookie will only be set on HTTPS clients.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login — request did not require it, but flagging for production hardening.

compass is in CORPORATE_BLACKLIST as substring — will also match any brokerage containing the word 'compass' (e.g. 'Compass Point Realty'). Might be intentional 'manual review' flag, but currently produces auto-rejection.
GET /api/admin/leads returns Mongo docs with `_id` popped correctly; consistent handling.
No unique constraint or dedupe on lead submissions — same email can submit unlimited leads.
test_credentials: Admin perkinsappraisal@gmail.com / ChangeMe!2026 works. Agents are dynamically created via /api/agents/apply during tests.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates TEST_-prefixed / uuid-tagged agents, leads, contracts, and one deal. No cleanup implemented — safe because data is uniquely tagged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (must use -n 0 to disable xdist parallelism; the tests share state across classes via pytest module attributes).
